question: Can you find 5 delivery drivers with the highest average number of daily deliveries?
sql:
-- Compute average daily deliveries per driver (total deliveries / distinct days with deliveries)
SELECT 
    d.driver_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_deliveries,
    COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(o.order_created_year || '-' || o.order_created_month || '-' || o.order_created_day)) as distinct_days,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(o.order_created_year || '-' || o.order_created_month || '-' || o.order_created_day)), 2) as avg_daily_deliveries
FROM deliveries d
LEFT JOIN orders o ON d.delivery_order_id = o.order_id
WHERE d.driver_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.driver_id
ORDER BY avg_daily_deliveries DESC
LIMIT 5
